The authors consider three astrophysical environments: shock-heated primordial gas, collapsing primordial gas in minihaloes, and initially ionized collapsing primordial gas in relic Hii regions.

The authors find that LiH cooling has no effect on the thermal evolution of the primordial gas in any of the three environments considered, even with the primordial lithium abundance enhanced by one order of magnitude.
